review.evidence: At mantra block 18531313, symbol/decimals and EIP-1967 implementation/admin were re-read. Local backing balance was 439,646.447844 M against 434,703.845695 mantraUSD supply. M-extension wrapping and unwrapping conserve the deposited M claim. The current SwapFacility restricts direct M output to approved swappers; an unprivileged sample canSwapViaPath(child,wM) returned true while child-to-M returned false. This is technical conversion eligibility, not a sent transaction or a cash redemption right. Local role/proxy reach is authored separately from inherited M authority and the parent bridge layer. Calibration provenance (2026-10-03): original umbrella observations retained verbatim: ["EOA upgrade-owner operational key custody is undisclosed; no enforceable delay has been established.", "Close all local role holders and SwapFacility governance; Safe owner/threshold and terminal module pagination are enumerated, but executable fallback-handler noninterference and signer independence remain unestablished."]. Human independence and key custody remain unverified and are priced by their dedicated control signals; financial/legal safeguards remain Backing-domain gaps. Calibration v2 (2026-10-03) reconsidered every prior removal and scoped move. Prior scoped observations retained verbatim: ["No enforceable delay on the named mantraUSD ProxyAdmin-owner upgrade path has been established; operational key custody is a separate, preserved disclosure gap.", "Close the current mantraUSD local SwapFacility governance, permission and upgrade-control reach at mantra:0xb6807116b3b1b321a390594e31ecd6e0076f6278."]. Genuine unknown implementation, controller authorization and unreadable execution state are retained as umbrella questions; identified-signer custody/independence is recorded per control, not asserted to be independently scored or resolved. Field re-justification: reconciliation=continuous describes the cited local parent-token custody and wrap/custodian supply-accounting mechanism only. It does not certify the upstream fiat/Treasury book, independent assurance or holder insolvency priority; supervision=unknown supplies no prudential or attestation-based credit.
